review_scope: Both complete own-source Uzbek Cyrillic body paragraphs and the title, before inspecting the previous review decision. No source-site request or external attribution lookup.

fields.content: A report is transmitted from Amr ibn al-Harith ibn Mustaliq. His printed statement expressly uses a passive attribution, 'it was said', before a finite saying about two people facing severe punishment: a wife disobeying her husband and an imam disliked by his people.
fields.provisional_disposition: Potentially eligible as an attributed transmission of an anonymous saying under the expanded reports-and-sayings policy. Keep the full passive wording and actual named relayer. The text does not name the ultimate origin of the saying, designate the relayer a Companion, or attribute the saying to the Prophet.
fields.boundaries: The complete paragraph is coherent narration framing plus a finite quoted saying; no lexical gloss, footnote marker, verse locator, or detachable compiler commentary occurs inside it.
fields.limitations: No canonical hadith number, external identity, grade or ultimate speaker can be supplied from this paragraph. This is a content-classification proposal, not an authenticity finding.

fields.content: Jarir says that Mansur said that, when they asked about the imam, they were told the reference was only to transgressing imams; for an imam who performs the Sunnah, the fault is with those who dislike him.
fields.provisional_disposition: Retain as the source's separate explanatory dialogue/commentary on the imam phrase. It qualifies the preceding saying and must stay available alongside it. Do not make this explanation into another numbered narration or label the unknown responder as the Prophet.
fields.boundaries: Retain the full paragraph exactly in source context; the named relayers and anonymous answering voice are different levels of attribution. Preserve the source's unbalanced quotation punctuation without repairing it.

title.meaning: A person whom the people do not want serving as their imam.
title.disposition: Publisher topic heading only; not narration text.
